result.brief: 提出统一 token 扩散模型 Modaliff，用逐 token 属性与角色化位置编码在原生潜序列中联合建模文本、图像与音频，实现单一去噪器支持任意到任意生成。
result.reason: Unified any-to-any token diffusion model with per-token attributes and role-based positional embeddings preserving native modality latents; directly a unified understanding/generation contribution.
